notes.title: 🎃The Night of Veils Awaits!🎃
notes.content:
From October 31 to November 15, 2024, the Tower transforms for a special Halloween event! A new door has mysteriously appeared, leading to untold horrors and hidden treasures. Will you dare to open it?
